Equivalent: the map file a held run's key names is a placeholder each key spells the same way, so any text in its place gives every run the same key, and the key is never read but to find the map again.

Equivalent: readAtMost reads one byte past the limit to tell a file past it from one at it. Reading more than one past, or the floor that keeps a negative limit from reaching file_get_contents, changes nothing a caller sees: a file past the limit is TooLarge however many bytes past it were read.
